detail.longDescription: 🐟 NEW: # MIT engineers built a # robot swimmer the size of a stick of gum, powered by a single sheet of living # mouse muscle less than 15 µm thick. # Light at 470 µm makes the # cells contract, bending gel fins to steer it through a maze at four body lengths per minute. Grooved channels align the cells, and daily light workouts quadruple their stroke. 👉 https://www. zmescience.com/science/news-sc ience/a-paper-thin-robot-swims-using-living-muscle-cells-steered-by-light/ # robotics # muscle # science # engineering # biology # technology # tech # swimming # research
